ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 15
   D. 17

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 14

3. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 48

5. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 13
   D. 9

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

13. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 1

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

16. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²

Final Answer: 13 cm
